body_markdown:
Earlier this year, we gave ARMY the chance to put their BTS knowledge to the test with Spotify’s first


[Music Quiz](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-03-20/bts-arirang-music-quiz/) . Now, we’re bringing the experience to even more fans.


Starting today, Music Quiz is rolling out across 11 countries with quizzes for more than 2,000 artists, giving Premium listeners a new way to test what they know about the artists and music they love.


Fans can test their knowledge through music trivia, album cover art reveals, and see if they can name that song from an audio track preview spanning an artist’s music catalog, career milestones, and defining moments. Then, they can see how well they scored and share their results with friends.


Here’s how it works:


**1. Update your Spotify app.** Make sure you’re on the latest version of Spotify.


**2. Find Music Quiz.** Play a track from a participating artist, then scroll down in the Now Playing view to find the Music Quiz card.


**3. Put your knowledge to the test.** Tap to start answering questions about the artist and their music.


**4. See how you did.** Finish the quiz to reveal your score.


**5. Share your results.** Show off your music knowledge and challenge your friends to see how they stack up.


[https://storage.googleapis.com/pr-newsroom-wp/1/2026/10/MusicQuiz_NA_16-9-smaller-12804834024.mp4](https://storage.googleapis.com/pr-newsroom-wp/1/2026/10/MusicQuiz_NA_16-9-smaller-12804834024.mp4)


Music Quiz is beginning to roll out to Premium users 18+ in the U.S., U.K., Canada, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, India, Nigeria, South Africa, and Indonesia. Quizzes for select artists are in English at launch with more artists, languages, and markets to come. We’re rolling this out gradually, so it may not show up for every artist or every listener right away.


Whether you’re a diehard fan who knows every lyric, deep cut, and career milestone or you just want to learn more, keep an eye out for Music Quiz the next time you’re listening to one of your favorite artists.
